name: Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: windows-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup MSVC Developer Command Prompt
        uses: ilammy/msvc-dev-cmd@v1
        with:
          arch: x64

      - name: Install OpenSSL via Chocolatey
        run: choco install openssl -y --no-progress

      - name: Create deps directory
        shell: bash
        run: mkdir -p deps

      - name: Clone UxPlay v1.73.6
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 --branch v1.73.6 \
            https://github.com/FDH2/UxPlay.git deps/UxPlay

      # OBS 32+ rejects modules built against a newer libobs. Building with the
      # oldest supported SDK produces one binary that loads on OBS 30 and newer.
      - name: Download baseline OBS Studio SDK 30.0.0
        shell: bash
        run: |
          curl -L -o deps/obs-sdk.zip \
            "https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/archive/refs/tags/30.0.0.zip"
          mkdir -p deps/obs-sdk
          cd deps/obs-sdk
          unzip -q ../obs-sdk.zip

      - name: Create obsconfig.h for OBS SDK
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > deps/obs-sdk/obs-studio-30.0.0/libobs/obsconfig.h << 'EOF'
          #pragma once
          #define OBS_DATA_PATH "data"
          #define OBS_PLUGIN_PATH "obs-plugins/64bit"
          #define OBS_PLUGIN_DESTINATION "obs-plugins/64bit"
          #define OBS_RELEASE_CANDIDATE 0
          #define OBS_BETA 0
          EOF

      # Ship our own FFmpeg 7 DLLs. OBS 32.2 moved to FFmpeg 8 and no longer
      # contains the avcodec-61/avutil-59 DLLs this plugin was linked against.
      - name: Download FFmpeg 7.1 shared runtime and SDK
        shell: bash
        run: |
          curl -L -o deps/ffmpeg7-shared.zip \
            "https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases/download/latest/ffmpeg-n7.1-latest-win64-lgpl-shared-7.1.zip"
          mkdir -p deps/ffmpeg7-extract
          unzip -q deps/ffmpeg7-shared.zip -d deps/ffmpeg7-extract
          mv deps/ffmpeg7-extract/ffmpeg-* deps/ffmpeg7-runtime
          for file in \
            include/libavcodec/avcodec.h lib/avcodec.lib \
            bin/avcodec-61.dll bin/avutil-59.dll \
            bin/swscale-8.dll bin/swresample-5.dll; do
            test -f "deps/ffmpeg7-runtime/$file" || exit 1
          done

      - name: Download libplist 2.7.0
        shell: bash
        run: |
          curl -L -o deps/libplist.zip \
            "https://github.com/libimobiledevice/libplist/archive/refs/tags/2.7.0.zip"
          cd deps && unzip -q libplist.zip

      - name: Create libplist config.h
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > deps/libplist-2.7.0/config.h << 'EOF'
          #pragma once
          #define PACKAGE_VERSION "2.7.0"
          #define PACKAGE_NAME "libplist"
          #define PACKAGE_STRING "libplist 2.7.0"
          #define HAVE_STRDUP 1
          #define HAVE_STDINT_H 1
          #define HAVE_STDLIB_H 1
          #define HAVE_STRING_H 1
          #ifdef _MSC_VER
          #define strcasecmp _stricmp
          #define strncasecmp _strnicmp
          #define strdup _strdup
          #ifndef ssize_t
          #include <basetsd.h>
          typedef SSIZE_T ssize_t;
          #endif
          #endif
          EOF

      - name: Create libplist CMakeLists.txt
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > deps/libplist-2.7.0/CMakeLists.txt << 'EOF'
          cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
          project(libplist C CXX)
          add_library(plist STATIC
              src/base64.c src/bplist.c src/bytearray.c src/hashtable.c
              src/jplist.c src/jsmn.c src/oplist.c src/out-default.c
              src/out-limd.c src/out-plutil.c src/plist.c src/ptrarray.c
              src/time64.c src/xplist.c
              libcnary/cnary.c libcnary/node.c libcnary/node_list.c
          )
          target_include_directories(plist PUBLIC
              ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
              ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libcnary/include
              ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
              ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
          )
          target_compile_definitions(plist PRIVATE HAVE_CONFIG_H=1 _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS _CRT_NONSTDC_NO_DEPRECATE)
          if(MSVC)
              target_compile_options(plist PRIVATE /wd4244 /wd4267 /wd4996 /wd4018 /wd4047 /wd4024 /wd4789)
          endif()
          EOF

      - name: Build libplist
        shell: cmd
        run: |
          cd deps\libplist-2.7.0
          if exist build rmdir /s /q build
          mkdir build
          cd build
          cmake .. -G "NMake Makefiles" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=cl
          nmake

      - name: Create def files
        shell: bash
        run: |
          # Create .def files if not present
          cat > deps/obs.def << 'EOFDEF'
          LIBRARY obs
          EXPORTS
              obs_register_source
              obs_register_source_s
              obs_source_output_video
              obs_source_output_audio
              obs_data_get_string
              obs_data_get_int
              obs_data_get_bool
              obs_data_set_default_string
              obs_data_set_default_int
              obs_data_set_default_bool
              obs_properties_create
              obs_properties_add_text
              obs_properties_add_int
              obs_properties_add_bool
              obs_properties_add_list
              obs_property_list_add_string
              obs_property_list_add_int
              obs_get_locale
              blog
              blogva
              bzalloc
              bmalloc
              bfree
              bmemdup
              bstrdup
              os_gettime_ns
              text_lookup_destroy
              text_lookup_getstr
              obs_module_load_locale
              obs_module_get_config_path
          EOFDEF

          cat > deps/w32-pthreads.def << 'EOFDEF'
          LIBRARY w32-pthreads
          EXPORTS
              pthread_create
              pthread_join
              pthread_mutex_init
              pthread_mutex_destroy
              pthread_mutex_lock
              pthread_mutex_unlock
              pthread_cond_init
              pthread_cond_destroy
              pthread_cond_signal
              pthread_cond_broadcast
              pthread_cond_wait
              pthread_cond_timedwait
          EOFDEF

          # dnssd.dll is loaded dynamically by UxPlay 1.73's dnssd.c - no import lib needed

      - name: Generate import libraries from def files
        shell: cmd
        run: |
          lib /def:deps\obs.def /out:deps\obs.lib /machine:x64
          lib /def:deps\w32-pthreads.def /out:deps\w32-pthreads.lib /machine:x64

      - name: Set OpenSSL path
        id: openssl
        shell: bash
        run: |
          OPENSSL_DIR="C:/Program Files/OpenSSL"
          if [ -d "C:/Program Files/OpenSSL-Win64" ]; then
            OPENSSL_DIR="C:/Program Files/OpenSSL-Win64"
          fi
          echo "dir=$OPENSSL_DIR" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "OpenSSL dir: $OPENSSL_DIR"
          # Debug: show lib directory contents
          find "$OPENSSL_DIR" -name "*.lib" 2>/dev/null | head -20 || echo "No .lib files found"

      - name: Apply UxPlay Windows patches and create build config
        shell: bash
        run: |
          UXLIB="deps/UxPlay/lib"

          # Patch compat.h - add winsock2, clock_gettime shim (MSVC), remove snprintf macro
          sed -i 's/#include <ws2tcpip.h>/#include <winsock2.h>\n#include <ws2tcpip.h>/' "$UXLIB/compat.h"
          sed -i '/#ifndef snprintf/,/#endif/d' "$UXLIB/compat.h"
          # clock_gettime shim: raop_ntp.c only uses CLOCK_REALTIME. Use
          # GetSystemTimePreciseAsFileTime (<1us) - AirPlay NTP sync needs
          # sub-millisecond wall-clock precision or the sender never locks
          # its clock and withholds audio. Re-audit if a future UxPlay bump
          # starts using CLOCK_MONOTONIC.
          sed -i '/#include <windows.h>/a #include <time.h>\n#ifndef CLOCK_REALTIME\n#define CLOCK_REALTIME 0\nstatic __inline int uxshim_clock_gettime(int clk, struct timespec *ts) { FILETIME ft; ULARGE_INTEGER ui; (void)clk; GetSystemTimePreciseAsFileTime(\&ft); ui.LowPart = ft.dwLowDateTime; ui.HighPart = ft.dwHighDateTime; ui.QuadPart -= 116444736000000000ULL; ts->tv_sec = (long long)(ui.QuadPart / 10000000ULL); ts->tv_nsec = (long)((ui.QuadPart % 10000000ULL) * 100); return 0; }\n#define clock_gettime uxshim_clock_gettime\n#endif' "$UXLIB/compat.h"

          # Patch threads.h - Windows branch for w32-pthreads (no unistd.h/usleep
          # on MSVC; plain pthread_create since w32-pthreads pthread_t is a struct
          # and upstream's "handle = 0" failure marker would not compile)
          cat > "$UXLIB/threads.h" << 'THEOF'
          #ifndef THREADS_H
          #define THREADS_H
          #if defined(WIN32) || defined(_WIN32)
          #include <windows.h>
          #include <pthread.h>
          #define sleepms(x) Sleep(x)
          #else
          #include <pthread.h>
          #include <unistd.h>
          #define sleepms(x) usleep((x)*1000)
          #endif
          typedef pthread_t thread_handle_t;
          #define THREAD_RETVAL void *
          #define THREAD_CREATE(handle, func, arg) pthread_create(&(handle), NULL, func, arg)
          #define THREAD_JOIN(handle) pthread_join(handle, NULL)
          typedef pthread_mutex_t mutex_handle_t;
          typedef pthread_cond_t cond_handle_t;
          #define MUTEX_CREATE(handle) pthread_mutex_init(&(handle), NULL)
          #define MUTEX_LOCK(handle) pthread_mutex_lock(&(handle))

@echo off
REM ============================================
REM OBS AirPlay Receiver - Windows Build Script
REM ============================================
REM
REM Prerequisites:
REM   1. Visual Studio 2019/2022 with C/C++ workload
REM   2. CMake 3.16+
REM   3. Dependencies prepared under deps (see README)
REM
REM Optional overrides:
REM   OPENSSL_DIR - Path to OpenSSL
REM   FFMPEG_ROOT - Path to the FFmpeg 7 shared SDK/runtime
REM
REM Example:
REM   set OPENSSL_DIR=C:\OpenSSL
REM   set FFMPEG_ROOT=C:\ffmpeg-7.1-shared
REM   build.bat
REM ============================================

if not exist "deps\obs-sdk\obs-studio-30.0.0\libobs" (
    echo ERROR: Missing baseline OBS 30.0.0 SDK under deps\obs-sdk.
    echo See README.md Building from Source.
    exit /b 1
)

if defined FFMPEG_ROOT (
    echo Using FFMPEG_ROOT: %FFMPEG_ROOT%
    set FFMPEG_CMAKE=-DFFMPEG_ROOT="%FFMPEG_ROOT%"
) else (
    echo Using FFmpeg from deps\ffmpeg7-runtime
    set FFMPEG_CMAKE=
)

if defined OPENSSL_DIR (
    set OPENSSL_CMAKE=-DOPENSSL_DIR="%OPENSSL_DIR%"
) else (
    set OPENSSL_CMAKE=
)

REM Create build directory
if not exist build mkdir build
cd build

REM Configure with CMake
cmake .. -G "Visual Studio 17 2022" -A x64 ^
    %FFMPEG_CMAKE% ^
    %OPENSSL_CMAKE%

if errorlevel 1 (
    echo.
    echo CMake configuration failed!
    echo Make sure the dependencies in deps\ are prepared correctly.
    cd ..
    exit /b 1
)

REM Build
cmake --build . --config Release

if errorlevel 1 (
    echo.
    echo Build failed!
    cd ..
    exit /b 1
)

echo.
echo ============================================
echo Build successful!
echo.
echo To install, run:
echo   cmake --install . --config Release
echo.
echo Or manually copy:
echo   build\Release\obs-airplay-receiver.dll
echo   to: %%APPDATA%%\obs-studio\plugins\obs-airplay-receiver\bin\64bit\
echo ============================================

cd ..

#!/bin/bash
# ============================================
# OBS AirPlay Receiver - Linux/macOS Build
# ============================================
#
# Prerequisites:
#   - cmake, gcc/clang, pkg-config
#   - obs-studio development headers (libobs-dev)
#   - ffmpeg development headers (libavcodec-dev, libavutil-dev, libswscale-dev)
#
# Ubuntu/Debian:
#   sudo apt install cmake build-essential pkg-config \
#     libobs-dev libavcodec-dev libavutil-dev libswscale-dev
#
# macOS (Homebrew):
#   brew install cmake ffmpeg obs
#

set -e

BUILD_DIR="build"
BUILD_TYPE="${BUILD_TYPE:-Release}"

mkdir -p "$BUILD_DIR"
cd "$BUILD_DIR"

cmake .. \
    -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE="$BUILD_TYPE" \
    ${OBS_DIR:+-DOBS_DIR="$OBS_DIR"} \
    ${FFMPEG_DIR:+-DFFMPEG_DIR="$FFMPEG_DIR"}

cmake --build . --config "$BUILD_TYPE" -j$(nproc 2>/dev/null || sysctl -n hw.ncpu 2>/dev/null || echo 4)

echo ""
echo "============================================"
echo "Build successful!"
echo ""
echo "To install:"
echo "  cmake --install . --config $BUILD_TYPE"
echo ""
echo "Or manually copy:"
echo "  ${BUILD_DIR}/obs-airplay-receiver.so"
echo "  to: ~/.config/obs-studio/plugins/obs-airplay-receiver/bin/64bit/"
echo "============================================"

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(obs-airplay-receiver VERSION 2.2.0 LANGUAGES C)

# --- Paths ---
set(DEPS_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/deps")

# UxPlay built libs
set(UXPLAY_BUILD_DIR "${DEPS_DIR}/uxplay-build/build")
set(UXPLAY_LIB_DIR "${DEPS_DIR}/UxPlay/lib")

# OBS headers. Build against the oldest supported release so OBS 32+'s module
# version gate also accepts this binary. Newer hosts remain API compatible.
set(OBS_SDK_VERSION "30.0.0" CACHE STRING "Oldest supported OBS SDK")
set(OBS_SRC_DIR "${DEPS_DIR}/obs-sdk/obs-studio-${OBS_SDK_VERSION}"
    CACHE PATH "OBS Studio source/SDK root")

# Private FFmpeg 7 runtime. These DLLs ship beside the plugin, so an OBS
# upgrade from FFmpeg 7 to 8 does not make the module unloadable.
set(FFMPEG_ROOT "${DEPS_DIR}/ffmpeg7-runtime"
    CACHE PATH "FFmpeg 7 shared development package root")
set(FFMPEG_INCLUDE_DIR "${FFMPEG_ROOT}/include")
set(FFMPEG_LIB_DIR "${FFMPEG_ROOT}/lib")
set(FFMPEG_RUNTIME_DIR "${FFMPEG_ROOT}/bin")

# OpenSSL
if(NOT DEFINED OPENSSL_DIR OR OPENSSL_DIR STREQUAL "")
    if(DEFINED ENV{OPENSSL_ROOT_DIR})
        set(OPENSSL_DIR "$ENV{OPENSSL_ROOT_DIR}")
    elseif(EXISTS "C:/Program Files/OpenSSL-Win64")
        set(OPENSSL_DIR "C:/Program Files/OpenSSL-Win64")
    elseif(EXISTS "C:/Program Files/OpenSSL")
        set(OPENSSL_DIR "C:/Program Files/OpenSSL")
    else()
        set(OPENSSL_DIR "C:/Users/kitti/scoop/apps/openssl/current")
    endif()
endif()
set(OPENSSL_DIR "${OPENSSL_DIR}" CACHE PATH "OpenSSL installation root")

# Find OpenSSL libcrypto
find_library(OPENSSL_CRYPTO_LIB NAMES libcrypto crypto libcrypto-3-x64
    PATHS
        "${OPENSSL_DIR}/lib"
        "${OPENSSL_DIR}/lib/VC"
        "${OPENSSL_DIR}/lib/VC/x64"
        "${OPENSSL_DIR}/lib/VC/x64/MD"
        "${OPENSSL_DIR}/lib/VC/x64/MT"
        "${OPENSSL_DIR}/lib/VC/x86_64"
    NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
if(NOT OPENSSL_CRYPTO_LIB)
    find_library(OPENSSL_CRYPTO_LIB NAMES libcrypto crypto)
endif()
message(STATUS "OpenSSL crypto lib: ${OPENSSL_CRYPTO_LIB}")

foreach(REQUIRED_DIR
        "${OBS_SRC_DIR}/libobs"
        "${OBS_SRC_DIR}/deps/w32-pthreads"
        "${FFMPEG_INCLUDE_DIR}"
        "${FFMPEG_LIB_DIR}")
    if(NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${REQUIRED_DIR}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Required dependency directory not found: ${REQUIRED_DIR}")
    endif()
endforeach()

if(NOT OPENSSL_CRYPTO_LIB)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "OpenSSL libcrypto import library was not found")
endif()

# libplist
set(LIBPLIST_DIR "${DEPS_DIR}/libplist-2.7.0")

# --- Plugin shared library ---
add_library(obs-airplay-receiver MODULE
    src/plugin-main.c
    src/airplay-source.c
    src/video-decoder.c
    src/audio-decoder.c
)

# --- Include directories ---
target_include_directories(obs-airplay-receiver PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src
    # OBS headers
    ${OBS_SRC_DIR}/libobs
    ${OBS_SRC_DIR}/deps/w32-pthreads
    # UxPlay headers (raop.h, dnssd.h, stream.h, logger.h)
    ${UXPLAY_LIB_DIR}
    ${UXPLAY_LIB_DIR}/playfair
    ${UXPLAY_LIB_DIR}/llhttp
    # libplist headers
    ${LIBPLIST_DIR}/include
    # FFmpeg headers
    ${FFMPEG_INCLUDE_DIR}
    # OpenSSL headers
    ${OPENSSL_DIR}/include
)

# --- Link libraries ---
# UxPlay static libs
target_link_libraries(obs-airplay-receiver PRIVATE
    ${UXPLAY_BUILD_DIR}/airplay.lib
    ${UXPLAY_BUILD_DIR}/playfair.lib
    ${UXPLAY_BUILD_DIR}/llhttp.lib
)

# libplist
target_link_libraries(obs-airplay-receiver PRIVATE
    ${LIBPLIST_DIR}/build/plist.lib
)

# OBS
target_link_libraries(obs-airplay-receiver PRIVATE ${DEPS_DIR}/obs.lib)

# OpenSSL
target_link_libraries(obs-airplay-receiver PRIVATE
    ${OPENSSL_CRYPTO_LIB}
)

# FFmpeg
target_link_directories(obs-airplay-receiver PRIVATE ${FFMPEG_LIB_DIR})
target_link_libraries(obs-airplay-receiver PRIVATE
    avcodec avutil swscale swresample
)

# Windows (dnssd.dll is loaded dynamically by UxPlay's dnssd.c at runtime)
target_link_libraries(obs-airplay-receiver PRIVATE
    ws2_32 iphlpapi
    ${DEPS_DIR}/w32-pthreads.lib
)

target_compile_definitions(obs-airplay-receiver PRIVATE
    WIN32
    _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS
    WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
    LIBPLIST_STATIC
    PLUGIN_VERSION="${PROJECT_VERSION}"
)

set_target_properties(obs-airplay-receiver PROPERTIES
    C_STANDARD 11
    C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
    PREFIX ""
)

# Install
set(OBS_PLUGIN_DEST "$ENV{PROGRAMDATA}/obs-studio/plugins/obs-airplay-receiver/bin/64bit")
install(TARGETS obs-airplay-receiver DESTINATION ${OBS_PLUGIN_DEST})

set(FFMPEG_RUNTIME_FILES
    "${FFMPEG_RUNTIME_DIR}/avcodec-61.dll"
    "${FFMPEG_RUNTIME_DIR}/avutil-59.dll"
    "${FFMPEG_RUNTIME_DIR}/swscale-8.dll"
    "${FFMPEG_RUNTIME_DIR}/swresample-5.dll"
)
foreach(RUNTIME_FILE IN LISTS FFMPEG_RUNTIME_FILES)
    if(NOT EXISTS "${RUNTIME_FILE}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Required FFmpeg runtime not found: ${RUNTIME_FILE}")
    endif()
endforeach()
install(FILES ${FFMPEG_RUNTIME_FILES} DESTINATION ${OBS_PLUGIN_DEST})

@echo off
REM ============================================
REM OBS AirPlay Receiver - Installer
REM Run as Administrator
REM ============================================

set "PLUGIN_DIR=%PROGRAMDATA%\obs-studio\plugins\obs-airplay-receiver\bin\64bit"
set "SCRIPT_DIR=%~dp0"

echo.
echo OBS AirPlay Receiver - Installer
echo =================================
echo.

REM Create plugin directory
if not exist "%PLUGIN_DIR%" (
    echo Creating directory: %PLUGIN_DIR%
    mkdir "%PLUGIN_DIR%"
    if errorlevel 1 (
        echo.
        echo ERROR: Failed to create directory. Please run as Administrator.
        pause
        exit /b 1
    )
)

REM Copy plugin DLL
echo Copying obs-airplay-receiver.dll...
copy /y "%SCRIPT_DIR%obs-airplay-receiver.dll" "%PLUGIN_DIR%\" >nul
if errorlevel 1 (
    echo ERROR: Failed to copy obs-airplay-receiver.dll
    pause
    exit /b 1
)

REM Copy the private FFmpeg 7 runtime. OBS 32.2+ ships FFmpeg 8, so the
REM plugin cannot rely on OBS itself to provide these ABI-specific DLLs.
echo Copying FFmpeg runtime DLLs...
for %%F in (avcodec-61.dll avutil-59.dll swscale-8.dll swresample-5.dll) do (
    if not exist "%SCRIPT_DIR%%%F" (
        echo ERROR: Missing required file %%F
        pause
        exit /b 1
    )
    copy /y "%SCRIPT_DIR%%%F" "%PLUGIN_DIR%\" >nul
    if errorlevel 1 (
        echo ERROR: Failed to copy %%F
        pause
        exit /b 1
    )
)

REM Copy OpenSSL dependency (version-agnostic)
echo Copying libcrypto DLL...
copy /y "%SCRIPT_DIR%libcrypto-*.dll" "%PLUGIN_DIR%\" >nul
if errorlevel 1 (
    echo ERROR: Failed to copy libcrypto DLL
    pause
    exit /b 1
)

REM Open firewall for AirPlay (audio arrives as inbound UDP)
echo Adding firewall rules...
netsh advfirewall firewall delete rule name="OBS AirPlay Receiver (UDP)" >nul 2>&1
netsh advfirewall firewall delete rule name="OBS AirPlay Receiver (TCP)" >nul 2>&1
netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="OBS AirPlay Receiver (UDP)" dir=in action=allow protocol=UDP localport=6000-6001,7011 >nul
netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="OBS AirPlay Receiver (TCP)" dir=in action=allow protocol=TCP localport=7000,7100 >nul

echo.
echo ============================================
echo Installation successful!
echo.
echo Plugin installed to:
echo   %PLUGIN_DIR%
echo.
echo Restart OBS Studio, then add a new source:
echo   Sources ^> + ^> AirPlay Receiver
echo ============================================
echo.
pause

[Setup]
AppName=OBS AirPlay Receiver
AppVersion=2.2.0
AppPublisher=aomkoyo
AppPublisherURL=https://github.com/aomkoyo/obs-airplay-receiver
DefaultDirName={commonappdata}\obs-studio\plugins\obs-airplay-receiver
DirExistsWarning=no
OutputDir=.
OutputBaseFilename=OBS-AirPlay-Receiver-Setup-v2.2.0
Compression=lzma2
SolidCompression=yes
PrivilegesRequired=admin
UninstallDisplayName=OBS AirPlay Receiver
WizardStyle=modern
DisableProgramGroupPage=yes

[Languages]
Name: "english"; MessagesFile: "compiler:Default.isl"

[Files]
Source: "artifact\obs-airplay-receiver.dll"; DestDir: "{app}\bin\64bit"; Flags: ignoreversion
Source: "artifact\libcrypto-*.dll"; DestDir: "{app}\bin\64bit"; Flags: ignoreversion
Source: "artifact\avcodec-61.dll"; DestDir: "{app}\bin\64bit"; Flags: ignoreversion
Source: "artifact\avutil-59.dll"; DestDir: "{app}\bin\64bit"; Flags: ignoreversion
Source: "artifact\swscale-8.dll"; DestDir: "{app}\bin\64bit"; Flags: ignoreversion
Source: "artifact\swresample-5.dll"; DestDir: "{app}\bin\64bit"; Flags: ignoreversion
Source: "artifact\README.md"; DestDir: "{app}"; Flags: ignoreversion

[Messages]
WelcomeLabel2=This will install the OBS AirPlay Receiver plugin.%n%nThis plugin lets you receive AirPlay screen mirroring from iPhone, iPad, and Mac directly as an OBS source.%n%nRequirements:%n- OBS Studio 30+%n- Apple Bonjour (install iTunes or Bonjour Print Services)
SelectDirLabel3=Select the OBS Studio plugins folder. The default should be correct for most installations.

[Code]
function FindOBSPluginDir: String;
var
  InstallPath: String;
begin
  // Try registry first
  if RegQueryStringValue(HKLM, 'SOFTWARE\OBS Studio', '', InstallPath) then
  begin
    Result := ExpandConstant('{commonappdata}') + '\obs-studio\plugins\obs-airplay-receiver';
    Exit;
  end;
  // Check common paths
  if DirExists(ExpandConstant('{commonpf}\obs-studio')) then
  begin
    Result := ExpandConstant('{commonappdata}') + '\obs-studio\plugins\obs-airplay-receiver';
    Exit;
  end;
  // Default
  Result := ExpandConstant('{commonappdata}') + '\obs-studio\plugins\obs-airplay-receiver';
end;

function NextButtonClick(CurPageID: Integer): Boolean;
begin
  Result := True;
end;

procedure InitializeWizard;
begin
  WizardForm.DirEdit.Text := FindOBSPluginDir;
end;

; AirPlay audio arrives as inbound UDP; open the plugin's fixed ports

# OBS AirPlay Receiver

[![Build](https://github.com/aomkoyo/obs-airplay-receiver/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/aomkoyo/obs-airplay-receiver/actions/workflows/build.yml)
[![License: LGPL v2.1](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-LGPL_v2.1-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/aomkoyo/obs-airplay-receiver)](https://github.com/aomkoyo/obs-airplay-receiver/releases)

An OBS Studio plugin that receives **AirPlay screen mirroring** from Apple devices (iPhone, iPad, Mac) on Windows and displays it as a video source with synchronized audio.

> **Built entirely with [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)** (Anthropic's AI coding agent) — from protocol implementation to CI/CD pipeline. This project is a Windows port of [mika314/obs-airplay](https://github.com/mika314/obs-airplay), using [UxPlay](https://github.com/FDH2/UxPlay)'s battle-tested AirPlay 2 protocol library.

## Features

- **Screen Mirroring** - Receive AirPlay screen mirroring as a native OBS source
- **Audio Support** - AAC audio decoded and synced with video
- **Configurable Resolution** - Set width and height to match your scene layout
- **Configurable FPS** - Control the maximum frame rate of the mirrored stream
- **Auto Discovery** - mDNS/Bonjour advertisement so Apple devices find the receiver automatically
- **Portable Decoding Runtime** - Bundles FFmpeg 7 so OBS's internal FFmpeg version can change safely
- **Low Latency** - Direct H.264 frame pipeline with minimal buffering

## Requirements

- **OBS Studio 30.0+** (single Windows x64 build for OBS 30, 31, and 32+)
- **Windows 10/11 64-bit**
- **Apple Bonjour** - Required for mDNS discovery so Apple devices can find the receiver. Install [Bonjour Print Services](https://support.apple.com/kb/DL999) package.

## Installation

1. Download the latest release `.zip` from the [Releases](../../releases) page
2. Extract the zip contents
3. Run `install.bat` as Administrator, or manually copy the files:
   - `obs-airplay-receiver.dll` to `%PROGRAMDATA%\obs-studio\plugins\obs-airplay-receiver\bin\64bit\`
   - `libcrypto-*-x64.dll` to the same directory
   - `avcodec-61.dll`, `avutil-59.dll`, `swscale-8.dll`, and
     `swresample-5.dll` to the same directory
4. Restart OBS Studio

To uninstall, run `uninstall.bat` as Administrator or delete the `%PROGRAMDATA%\obs-studio\plugins\obs-airplay-receiver` folder.

## Usage

1. Start OBS Studio
2. Click **+** under Sources and select **AirPlay Receiver**
3. Configure the source settings:
   - **Server Name** - How the receiver appears on Apple devices (default: "OBS AirPlay Receiver")
   - **Width / Height** - Resolution of the received stream
   - **Max FPS** - Maximum frame rate
4. On your Apple device, open **Control Center** > **Screen Mirroring** and select the server name
5. The mirrored screen appears in OBS with audio

### Firewall

If your Apple device cannot find the receiver, make sure Windows Firewall allows:
- **TCP port 7000** (AirPlay)
- **UDP port 5353** (mDNS/Bonjour)

## Building from Source

### Prerequisites

- Visual Studio 2019 or 2022 with C/C++ workload (MSVC compiler)
- CMake 3.16+
- OpenSSL (install via `choco install openssl` or Scoop)
- Git (for submodules)

### Steps

All commands below should be run from a **VS Developer Command Prompt**.

1. **Clone with submodules**
   ```bash
   git clone --recursive https://github.com/aomkoyo/obs-airplay-receiver.git
   cd obs-airplay-receiver
   ```

2. **Download dependencies** into the `deps/` directory:
   - **OBS Studio SDK** (30.0.0 compatibility baseline) - extract to
     `deps/obs-sdk/obs-studio-30.0.0/`
     ```bash
     curl -L -o deps/obs-sdk.zip https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/archive/refs/tags/30.0.0.zip
     cd deps && mkdir obs-sdk && cd obs-sdk && tar -xf ../obs-sdk.zip && cd ..\..
     ```
   - **FFmpeg 7.1 LGPL shared SDK/runtime** - extract to
     `deps/ffmpeg7-runtime/`; it must contain `include/`, `lib/`, and `bin/`
   - **libplist 2.7.0** - extract to `deps/libplist-2.7.0/`

3. **Generate import libraries** from OBS DLLs:
   ```bat
   lib /def:deps\obs.def /out:deps\obs.lib /machine:x64
   lib /def:deps\w32-pthreads.def /out:deps\w32-pthreads.lib /machine:x64
   ```

4. **Build libplist**
   ```bat
   cd deps\libplist-2.7.0
   mkdir build && cd build
   cmake .. -G "NMake Makefiles" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=cl
   nmake
   cd ..\..\..
   ```

5. **Build UxPlay libraries** (playfair, llhttp, airplay)
   ```bat
   cd deps\uxplay-build
   mkdir build && cd build
   cmake .. -G "NMake Makefiles" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=cl
   nmake
   cd ..\..\..
   ```

6. **Build the plugin**
   ```bat
   mkdir build && cd build
   cmake .. -G "NMake Makefiles" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=cl
   nmake
   ```

7. The output `obs-airplay-receiver.dll` will be in the `build/` directory.

## Troubleshooting

- **Device doesn't see the receiver** - Check that Bonjour is installed and Windows Firewall allows TCP 7000 and UDP 5353
- **No audio** - Ensure the source's audio monitoring is enabled in the OBS audio mixer
- **Error 126 / plugin not loaded after an OBS update** - Reinstall from the full
  v2.2.0+ zip or installer; all four bundled FFmpeg DLLs must be beside the plugin
- **One client at a time** - AirPlay screen mirroring supports a single connected device
